A bookmark names one commit, not its ancestry: `"main"@origin ~ ::(legion/INFRA-180@origin)` can only return main's tip, so it shows one commit where the forge shows ten. Use `::"main"@origin ~ ::(…)` and check it against gh api compare before concluding a set is empty — the architect's correction of its own earlier inference.
